product_description: After a long and stressful week, slip into bliss with Leading Lady dreamy comfort cotton crossover sleep and leisure bra, a.k.a. The weekender. If you've never experienced bra bliss, you'll find it here because the weekender is the bra you'll never want to take off. Light, breezy and truly dreamy, this comfort bra features a smooth double-layered crossover cup design giving your breasts gentle support in all the right places. The weekender is made of seamless breathable blended cotton fabric with an enhanced comfort band for added support and a wide back panel for subtle side and back smoothing. Translation: a beautiful silhouette that impeccably embraces your curves. Our Leading Lady crossover sleep and leisure bra doubles as a maternity bra and nursing bra for expectant and new moms. With easy pull-aside cups, breastfeeding has never been simpler at any hour, day or night. With a touch of spandex, the soft fabric adjusts to your ever-changing breasts during pregnancy and breastfeeding. The weekender's crossover cups keep nursing pads secure while moving or sleeping so you never have to worry about embarrassing or messy leaks again. Great for sleeping, snuggling with your baby or light leisure activities, Leading Lady crossover sleep and leisure bra is the ultimate weekend relaxation essential
